box.highlights: East Islip 48, Hauppauge 7: Leo Lopez ran for 103 yards and three touchdowns on eight carries for East Islip (1-0) in Suffolk III. His 4-yard touchdown in the first quarter gave East Islip a 6-0 lead. He added 34-yarder in the second quarter and a 46-yarder in the third. Derek Burrell ran for 105 yards and a touchdown on seven carries and Andrew Cooper added 61 yards and a touchdown on five carries.

East Islip 54, Islip 14: Leo Lopez made his presence known from the opening kickoff, and didn't slow down from there for East Islip. He returned the opening kick 91 yards for a touchdown and rushed for 121 yards and two touchdowns on 14 carries. Lopez also had two interceptions in the Suffolk III victory. Derek Burrell added 119 yards on eight carries and two touchdowns and David Reynolds added 156 yards on and a score on nine carries. Ryan Bayer had 11 tackles and East Islip rushed for 423 yards as a team. Kevin Smith made field goals of 39 and 23 yards and all four of his PATs.

East Islip 33, Westhampton 14: Leo Lopez ran for 211 yards and a touchdown on 25 carries in Suffolk III. Lopez' 99-yard touchdown run in the third quarter gave East Islip a 19-7 lead. Derek Burrell ran for 135 yards and a touchdown, threw two touchdown passes, and had a 70-yard interception return for a touchdown in the second quarter. Ryan Bauco and Jason Fiorello each caught touchdown passes. The East Islip defense had four interceptions - two by Andrew Cooper and one each by Jason Fiorello and Burrell. Ryan Bayer and Cooper Parkinson each made nine tackles to lead East Islip (3-0). Westhampton is 0-2.

East Islip 37, Comsewogue 15: Derek Burrell rushed for 136 and a touchdown on 18 carries and completed 6 for 9 for 96 yards and two touchdowns to lead East Islip (4-0) in Suffolk III. Leo Lopez rushed for 132 yards and two touchdowns on 19 carries and Dave Reynolds ran three times for 37 yards.

East Islip 42, Half Hollow Hills West 7: Derek Burrell completed 6 of 8 passes for 101 yards and a touchdown and ran for 65 yard and two touchdowns to lead East Islip (5-0) in Suffolk III. Leo Lopez ran for 51 yards and two touchdowns on eight carries, Aiden Lenox had an interception and Cooper Parkinson had a sack.

East Islip 38, Harborfields 0: Derek Burrell rushed for 86 yards and three touchdowns on nine carries and completed 6 of 9 passes for 101 yards to lead East Islip (6-1) in Suffolk III. Leo Lopez had a 59-yard interception return for a score in the fourth quarter and Aiden Lenox added a 28-yard fumble recovery later in the quarter to cap the scoring. Mike Baldino had a sack and a forced fumble and Lopez and Jason Fiorello each recovered fumbles.

East Islip 25, Kings Park 21: Derek Burrell rushed for 261 yards and two touchdowns on 19 carries and completed 3 of 4 passes for 36 yards for East Islip (7-1) in Suffolk III. Leo Lopez rushed for 133 yards and two touchdowns on 14 carries and stopped Kings Park on 4th and goal at the 3-yard line in the third quarter and Burrell broke up a 4th down pass in the fourth quarter to preserve the win. Kings Park is now 5-2. Kings Park quarterback Jonathan Borkowski carried the ball 25 times for 228 yards and a score. He was also 6-for-9 passing for 61 yards and a touchdown.

East Islip 30, Comsewogue 10: Leo Lopez ran for 58 yards and a touchdown on 15 carries and caught two passes for 66 yards and a touchdown to lead No. 2 East Islip over No. 7 Comsewogue in a Suffolk III quarterfinal. Derek Burrell threw two touchdowns and returned an interception for a score for East Islip. Jason Fiorello had an interception, AIden Lenox recovered a fumble and Andrew Cooper had 11 tackles. Comsewogue finishes 3-6.

East Islip 35, Sayville 28
Derek Burrell rushed 20 times for 178 yards and 3 touchdowns including the game winning 31 yard run with 19 seconds left in the Division III final for East Islip. Burrell also completed 7 of 8 passes for 116 yards. The turning point of the game came in the third quarter when Sayville had the ball at the East Islip 1 yard line. An errant center snap was fumbled and picked up by Cooper Parkinson who returned the fumble 94 yards for a 28-21 East Islip lead. Carson Tessitore and Ryan Bayer combined on two sacks for the Redmen. This was the first Suffolk title for the Redmen since 2016 and their eighth overall. Both teams are now 10-1.This was the 150th win in Sal J. Ciampi's career. He is 150-60 in his 21 year as  the coach of the Redmen. East Islip will play Plainedge in the Long Island Class III final on Friday November 26 at Hofstra University at 4:30 p.m.

Plainedge (12-0) rallied from a three-point halftime deficit with 19 unanswered points in the third quarter to win the Long Island Class III championship at Hofstra's Shuart Stadium. Dylan Pepe had 106 rushing yards and two touchdowns and Travis Shaver and Joe Iadevaio each had touchdown runs for the Red Devils. Shaver had 93 rushing yards including a 27-yard dash on a fourth-and-25 late in the game to keep the ball away from East Islip (10-2). Derek Burrell rushed for 151 yards and a touchdown and also threw for a touchdown for EI.
